QuestInfo.name: A Name on a Note
QuestInfo.0: #p207#, who lives in the little mushroom house in #m10001000#, seems to want to follow the clue written on #t4031122#.
QuestInfo.1: From #b#t4031122##k, which I obtained after defeating #o700000#, the one who'd attacked #p207#, I picked up two leads: #b#m10002000##k and #p602#. I think it'd be best to head to #b#m10005000##k first and go hear what #b#p602##k has to say.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I met #p602# at #m10005000#. It seems I might be able to track down the warrior who saved #p207# more easily than I thought.

0.0: Let's see... the note is old and torn, so it's hard to make out much. "Deep within #m10002000#... ...a way to purify the blood of... to #p602#..." Hmm... I can't quite make out any more than that. Cough... If it's #m10002000#, could that have something to do with the fairies in the forest to the east of here? I wonder who this #p602# could be.
0.1: #p602#... that name sounds familiar somehow, but I'm not sure who it is. I can't be certain this note really belongs to that warrior, but I think it'd be best to go find this #p602# person first... If you happen to run into them while you're out adventuring, would you mind asking if they know the warrior?

yes.0: Thank you so much! I do hope you're able to find him... cough... even the smallest clue would be wonderful. If you learn anything at all, please be sure to come back and tell me.

no.0: I see. I'm alright, really I am. Cough...

1.0:
Hmm...? You have business with me, is that it? You're looking for the owner of this #b#t4031122##k, I take it? Let me have a closer look. Hmm... I see... I have a fair idea of whose note this belongs to. But before I tell you anything about them, I need to know why you're looking for them. They don't seem to want much known about themselves, you see.

#b#L0# A girl named #b#p207# from #b#m010001000# is looking for the person who saved her.#l
#L1# They haven't paid back the money they owe me!#l
1.1:
I see, but I'm afraid I must apologize. Even so, I don't think it would be wise for me to tell you anything about them. I hope you'll understand.

#b#L0# I'll keep it a secret that you told me anything.#l
#L1# You might change your mind if you learn more about this girl.#l
1.2:
Is that so? Then go on and tell me about this girl.

#b#L0#She lost her parents when she was young, and for some reason, she's been growing weaker and weaker ever since.#l
#L1#She lives all alone, and she's been feeling terribly lonely.#l
1.3: Growing weaker for no known reason, you say... and a warrior saved her... don't tell me...! Ah, it's nothing. Hmm... well, if you're going to say that much, I suppose there's no helping it.

0.1: All the more reason I cannot tell you who that person is.

1.0: Heh... did you really think you could persuade me with something like that?

2.1: It's a shame to hear she's lonely, but I don't see how that person would be of any help to a girl like #p207#.

npc.0: According to #b#t4031122##k, it seems there's a chance that someone named #b#p602##k might know the warrior who saved me. If you happen to meet them, please be sure to ask about him.
